sv_vkLead: You hand over the marketing of your property with support. The exact scope is worked out in a personal conversation.
sv_vkTun1: An assessment of your property in a personal conversation
sv_vkTun2: Preparing the text and photos for the listing
sv_vkTun3: Marketing it on the Fourwalls marketplace
sv_vkSchritt1Text: You describe your property and your situation.
sv_vkSchritt2Text: We arrange a conversation, by phone or in person.
sv_vkSchritt3Text: You receive an assessment as a basis for the next steps.
sv_vkSchritt4Text: Once you agree, we prepare and market the listing.
sv_vkSchritt5Text: We support you through to closing.
sv_vkErwartenText: One fixed point of contact supports you through the process. Fees and mandate terms are agreed transparently in the personal conversation. We deliberately don't state a timeframe — it depends on the property and the market.
sv_vkAbgrenzungText: If you'd rather keep the text, photos and inquiries in your own hands, List it yourself is the right path.
sv_vkHerausgeber: This page is operated by Fourwalls.
sv_vkPlatzhalterHinweis: The address and contact details are placeholders until confirmed.
sv_vkNachAnfrage: We'll get back to you using the contact details you provide, to arrange a conversation.
sv_vkDatenhinweis: Your details are used only to process this request.
sv_vwLead: You'd like to hand over the management of your property. The scope is clarified in conversation. Based on the property and the desired scope of services, we prepare an individual proposal.
sv_vwThemenHinweis: Possible services are agreed to match the property and the mandate.
sv_vwSchritt1Text: You describe your property and your request.
sv_vwSchritt2Text: We clarify the possible scope of the collaboration.
sv_vwSchritt4Text: Once agreed, the collaboration starts on the agreed date.
sv_vwAbgrenzungText: For a single letting without ongoing management, Let is the right path.
sv_vmLead: You're looking for tenants for your property. We take note of your request and clarify next steps in conversation.
sv_vmErstHinweis: This also applies to first letting after completion or renovation.
sv_vmAbgrenzungText: For ongoing management beyond the letting itself, Request management is the right path.
